# noenv

> noenv is a self-hosted secrets manager that replaces .env files. Encrypted environment variables load into your shell when you cd into a git repository and unload when you leave. It runs on your own Cloudflare account (one Worker, one D1 database, one KV namespace).

- Values are encrypted on the developer's machine; the server stores only ciphertext.
- The git origin URL identifies the project. An optional .noenv file selects the environment.
- Changes from the CLI, the dashboard, or a teammate load at the next shell prompt.
- Every change is a new version, and any version can be restored.
- People sign in with passkeys and get reader, editor, or admin roles.
- Admins can warn about, block, or migrate and delete .env files on team machines.
- Coding agents, scripts, and CI run commands with `noenv exec -- <command>`.
- `noenv wrangler` pushes secrets to a Cloudflare Worker without printing them.

## Get started

- [Deploy to Cloudflare](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/thisisamank/noenv): one-click deployment
- [@thisisamank/noenv-cli on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@thisisamank/noenv-cli): `npm install -g @thisisamank/noenv-cli`
- [Source and README](https://github.com/thisisamank/noenv): setup steps, commands, and design

## Guides

- [Getting started](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/getting-started): deploy, create the admin passkey, connect the shell, add a project
- [Migrate from .env](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/migrate-from-env): move .env files into noenv and delete them safely
- [Multiple accounts](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/multiple-accounts): use one laptop and one CLI with several noenv deployments
- [Agents, CI, and Workers](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/agents-ci-and-workers): noenv exec for coding agents and CI, noenv wrangler to push secrets to Workers
- [Team and access](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/team-and-access): invites, roles, noenv grant, removing access
- [Policies and devices](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/guides/policies-and-devices): .env policy modes, CLI version, session expiry, compliance
- [Changelog](https://noenv.thisisamank.in/changelog): every release, newest first
